steps.message: Turn off WiFi, then enable bluetooth
Execute: adb shell "svc wifi disable; svc bluetooth enable"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "svc wifi disable; svc bluetooth enable""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "svc wifi status; svc bluetooth status"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "svc wifi status; svc bluetooth status""
